description: Asks the result and inner type of Switch and Choose for arms of different widths and types, Null results, an odd number of Switch arguments, no arguments, a Switch condition that is text, numeric or Null, Choose selectors that are Byte, Boolean, negative, past Long or text, a Choose with a Null or text arm, and Switch and Choose with 20 and 100 arms. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr, VarType(expr), TypeName(expr) FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
